summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited consolidated financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing discloses net revenues of NT$173,662 million, net income attributable to shareholders of NT$14,148 million, and basic EPS of NT$3.24 per share (US$0.205 per ADS). No merger, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is announced or discussed. This is a routine earnings release with no event-driven or catalyst implications. There is no deal to analyze or risk-arb angle to monitor.
